body_type: SHORT boxy Jeep Renegade: compact crossover, tall cabin, short wheelbase, short overhangs, stubby nose and tail. NOT a Jeep Compass (Compass is longer, softer, more sedan-crossover).
forbidden: DeLorean / wedge coupe / gull-wing / stainless; Jeep Compass / long stretched crossover / wagon; gun slid onto the hood or hanging past the windshield
base_color: Black Noir: matte black / charcoal body with light-gray edge highlights
wheels: chunky off-road tires, blocky tread, dark rims, wide stance, readable at 64px
grille: Jeep-style seven-slot vertical grille, light-gray outline
lights: two large round white headlights; small orange markers on the outer fenders; two small round fog lights in the lower bumper
bumper: heavy black bumper, light-gray license-plate rectangle, two bright red tow hooks / D-rings
hood: short hood, subtle central scoop, no DeLorean vents
roof_rails: two light-gray / silver longitudinal roof rails
windows: dark teal / cyan tint; two-box Renegade greenhouse (short, upright), not a long Compass cabin
paint_finish: arcade pixel art, limited black/gray/red palette, visible pixels, no chrome / PBR / photoreal
weapon: LOCKED: machine-gun TURRET sits in the CENTER of the roof (mid-cabin, between the rails), never over the windshield or hood. Barrel points FORWARD along the nose but the mount stays mid-roof. Short enough that the muzzle does not hang past the front bumper.
name: SUV Black Noir
